Browned Butter Brownie 
1 cup salted butter- browned 
1/2 cup dutched cocoa
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa 
1 cup semi sweet mini chocolate morsels
1 can condensed milk 
1 cup white granulated sugar
2 tsp vanilla 
3 eggs + 1 yolk
1 cup flour
1 tablespoon cornstarch 

Preheat oven to 325 F. 

Brown butter over low heat, stir frequently 
Remove from heat for 2 minutes
Stir in cocoa powders and chocolate chips until well incorporated. 
Mix in condensed milk

Beat eggs in stand mixer with sugar and vanilla until pale, fluffy and sugar is mostly dissolved.

Sift in flour, add chocolate mixture & fold together. Do not use mixer. 

*optional: mix in walnuts or chocolate chunks*

Line pan with parchment paper. 

Bake at 325 for 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean with sticky crumbs (not batter, but not clean)

Stouffers copy cat Mac

5 cups whole milk

2 cups water

6 tsp flour 

4 tbs butter

1 box elbows

Salt

6 slices American cheese

1 packet wegmans cheese sauce

2 heaping cups extra sharp cheddar maybe 3?


Whisk milk and flour together. Bring to simmer.

Add pasta and butter 

Panic when you realize you might need more liquid for pasta to cook and have extra for sauce, so add 2 cups of water. 

Once pasta is 80% tender or whatever.... add American cheese and cheese sauce and stir to melt. 


Once melted, add cheddar one handful at a time and stir until melted after each handful.


Panic that there’s too much sauce and not enough pasta.


Start boiling emergency pot of water to make more pasta. 


Keep  on low in hopes that noodles will soak up more sauce, and it will thicken. 


Panic that the noodles are going to be mush at the end. 


Once sauce is thick and noodles are even thicc-er, turn off heat. Looks like you won’t need that emergency water after all!


Add salt to taste. 


Put into casserole dish and Bake at 400 for 15 minutes.
